name: Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri Limited
summary: Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri Limited designs, manufactures, retails, and sells jewelry in India. The company offers bangles, pendants, rings, necklaces, bracelets, earrings, coins, and mangalsutras. It also provides products in a various style, such as gold, diamond studded, precious and semi-precious stone studded, and plain and diamond studded platinum; lightweight and contemporary jewelry; temple jewelry; jewelry with colored stones studded in gold and diamond; loose diamonds solitaires; gold bars; loose precious and semi-precious stones; and jadau jewelry.
